STEP 1 - Scene: A small mixed green salad (mesclun-style leaves with shredded carrot, dried cranberries or dark fruit pieces, and a few slivered almonds/seeds) on a white square plate, photographed from above at a slight angle. Most of the salad has been eaten or sits on one side; the rest of the plate is empty.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The plate is a square-ish white dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: mixed leafy greens (spinach/mesclun, some red-leaf), shredded carrot, dried cranberries/dark fruit, sliced almonds, a light dressing sheen.

STEP 4 - Area: mixed leafy greens ~17% (90 cm^2); shredded carrot ~1% (5 cm^2); dried fruit ~2% (10 cm^2); almonds ~0.5% (3 cm^2). Total food coverage ~21% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume: greens 90 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 225 ml; carrot 5 cm^2 x 0.5 cm = 2.5 ml; dried fruit 10 cm^2 x 0.8 cm = 8 ml; almonds 3 cm^2 x 0.3 cm = 1 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: greens 225 ml x 0.15 = 34 g; carrot 2.5 ml x 0.6 = 2 g; dried fruit 8 ml x 0.6 = 5 g; almonds 1 ml x 0.6 = 1 g. Dressing residue ~2 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: leafy greens 20 kcal/100 g → 34 g ≈ 7 kcal; carrot 41 kcal/100 g → 1 kcal; dried cranberries/fruit ~300 kcal/100 g → 15 kcal; almonds ~580 kcal/100 g → 6 kcal; dressing residue ~450 kcal/100 g → 9 kcal. Total ≈ 38 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 40–45 g of visible salad with ~40 kcal is plausible for a few mouthfuls of leftover greens on a large plate, since most of the salad appears to have been eaten.

Estimated total: about 43 g, about 38 kcal.
